blocks.text: Chatsworth is a residential treatment center that focuses on providing substance abuse and co-occurring disorder treatments. The facility is located in Montreal, Canada, and the specific location is only provided to those who attend the program. Chatsworth is unique due to its “Closed Group” therapeutic model. The program length is three weeks, with a maximum of six clients. The counselor provides intensive, uninterrupted therapy and treatment during this time. They are highly trained and experienced, providing care by offering new strategies, proactive solutions, and healthy lifestyle changes.

blocks.text: The “Closed Group” therapeutic model is a shorter program that allows counselors to provide more intensive, uninterrupted therapy and treatment in less time. The model is unique and helps detect patterns that cause self-defeating and self-destructive behaviors. The team pays special attention to the problems that an individual goes through during the addiction treatment process. It is a highly customizable treatment plan tailored according to individual needs. The 2:1 client to staff ratio ensures individualized attention, which facilitates more personalized care for clients. The treatment plan includes daily individual counseling, small group counseling, yoga, and lectures.

centre.name: Chatsworth
centre.about_html:
Chatsworth is a residential treatment center that focuses on providing substance abuse and co-occurring disorder treatments. The facility is located in Montreal, Canada, and the specific location is only provided to those who attend the program. Chatsworth is unique due to its “Closed Group” therapeutic model. The program length is three weeks, with a maximum of six clients. The counselor provides intensive, uninterrupted therapy and treatment during this time. They are highly trained and experienced, providing care by offering new strategies, proactive solutions, and healthy lifestyle changes. 

The “Closed Group” therapeutic model 

The “Closed Group” therapeutic model is a shorter program that allows counselors to provide more intensive, uninterrupted therapy and treatment in less time. The model is unique and helps detect patterns that cause self-defeating and self-destructive behaviors. The team pays special attention to the problems that an individual goes through during the addiction treatment process. It is a highly customizable treatment plan tailored according to individual needs. The 2:1 client to staff ratio ensures individualized attention, which facilitates more personalized care for clients. The treatment plan includes daily individual counseling, small group counseling, yoga, and lectures. 

Family Program 

Chatsworth provides a two-day family program geared towards those who want to help their loved ones to embark on the path to recovery. The program aims to motivate family members and loved ones by educating them about addiction and how to support their loved ones in their journey to recovery. The two-day program is designed to create a foundation between clients and their loved ones to ensure better outcomes and long-lasting success. 

Addiction Intervention 

Addiction intervention is available at Chatsworth for those who want to help their loved ones overcome addiction. An interventionist is available to provide guidance, which often includes an outline of the intervention process, identifying treatment options, and offering family members support and resources before, during, and after the intervention. The intervention is typically the first step in getting the individual to accept treatment and breaking free from addiction. 




Chatsworth - Center Overview

Chatsworth Rehab Center is a top-tier addiction treatment facility with an unparalleled reputation for excellence. Through the use of its unique “Closed Group” model, the center offers an innovative approach to addiction recovery that has helped many individuals struggling with substance abuse and co-occurring disorders rebuild their lives. The specialized program is designed to deliver focused and intensive therapy in a shorter amount of time, allowing residents to benefit from the benefits of traditional 28+ day treatment programs in just a 3-week span. Chatsworth’s brave and caring team of clinicians is committed to meeting the needs of each individual, with a 2:1 client to staff ratio that facilitates a highly personalized and customizable treatment plan.

At Chatsworth Rehab Center, clients receive daily one-on-one counseling, small group counseling, informative lectures, and rejuvenating yoga sessions, which help them learn new coping mechanisms and develop healthy lifestyle habits. The focus is on promoting sustained recovery by addressing the underlying problems that often contribute to self-destructive behaviors. With just six residents at a time, Chatsworth provides a warm and welcoming environment that encourages a sense of community among clients, helping them build supportive relationships that can endure long after their program ends. Chatsworth Rehab Center is dedicated to providing a safe and effective path to recovery that equips clients to take charge of their lives and embrace hope for the future.

Chatsworth is a residential treatment center that focuses on providing substance abuse and co-occurring disorder treatments. The facility is located in Montreal, Canada, and the specific location is only provided to those who attend the program. Chatsworth is unique due to its “Closed Group” therapeutic model. The program length is three weeks, with a maximum of six clients. The counselor provides intensive, uninterrupted therapy and treatment during this time. They are highly trained and experienced, providing care by offering new strategies, proactive solutions, and healthy lifestyle changes. 

The “Closed Group” therapeutic model 

The “Closed Group” therapeutic model is a shorter program that allows counselors to provide more intensive, uninterrupted therapy and treatment in less time. The model is unique and helps detect patterns that cause self-defeating and self-destructive behaviors. The team pays special attention to the problems that an individual goes through during the addiction treatment process. It is a highly customizable treatment plan tailored according to individual needs. The 2:1 client to staff ratio ensures individualized attention, which facilitates more personalized care for clients. The treatment plan includes daily individual counseling, small group counseling, yoga, and lectures. 

Family Program 

Chatsworth provides a two-day family program geared towards those who want to help their loved ones to embark on the path to recovery. The program aims to motivate family members and loved ones by educating them about addiction and how to support their loved ones in their journey to recovery. The two-day program is designed to create a foundation between clients and their loved ones to ensure better outcomes and long-lasting success. 

Addiction Intervention 

Addiction intervention is available at Chatsworth for those who want to help their loved ones overcome addiction. An interventionist is available to provide guidance, which often includes an outline of the intervention process, identifying treatment options, and offering family members support and resources before, during, and after the intervention. The intervention is typically the first step in getting the individual to accept treatment and breaking free from addiction. 




Chatsworth - Center Overview

Chatsworth Rehab Center is a top-tier addiction treatment facility with an unparalleled reputation for excellence. Through the use of its unique “Closed Group” model, the center offers an innovative approach to addiction recovery that has helped many individuals struggling with substance abuse and co-occurring disorders rebuild their lives. The specialized program is designed to deliver focused and intensive therapy in a shorter amount of time, allowing residents to benefit from the benefits of traditional 28+ day treatment programs in just a 3-week span. Chatsworth’s brave and caring team of clinicians is committed to meeting the needs of each individual, with a 2:1 client to staff ratio that facilitates a highly personalized and customizable treatment plan.

At Chatsworth Rehab Center, clients receive daily one-on-one counseling, small group counseling, informative lectures, and rejuvenating yoga sessions, which help them learn new coping mechanisms and develop healthy lifestyle habits. The focus is on promoting sustained recovery by addressing the underlying problems that often contribute to self-destructive behaviors. With just six residents at a time, Chatsworth provides a warm and welcoming environment that encourages a sense of community among clients, helping them build supportive relationships that can endure long after their program ends. Chatsworth Rehab Center is dedicated to providing a safe and effective path to recovery that equips clients to take charge of their lives and embrace hope for the future.
